categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Sinyuan ZM Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of magnesium alloy and aluminum alloy precision die-casting products and supporting die-casting molds. Its products mainly serve the automotive industry, including traditional and new energy vehicles, electric bicycles, and garden machinery tools. Key product categories include automotive display system components, new energy vehicle powertrain parts, automotive central control parts, automotive seat parts, automotive lighting parts, and high-cleanliness autonomous driving module parts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced non-ferrous metal die-casting and machining technologies, including high-pressure die casting and semi-solid die casting for magnesium alloys. It has developed a comprehensive core technology system covering mold design, die casting forming, post-processing, precision machining, and surface treatment. Key proprietary technologies include crack prevention forming, local pressure forming, ejection deformation control, electrostatic spraying for magnesium alloys, melting protection, dust collection, and processing of large, thin-walled, and complex castings. The company also invests in R&D for semi-solid forming and lightweight magnesium alloy components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are automotive manufacturers and suppliers, including well-known domestic and international brands such as BMW, Audi, Porsche, Cadillac, Volkswagen, General Motors, Peugeot, Ford, Nissan, Hongqi, Chery, Great Wall, IM Motors, NIO, XPeng, and Zeekr. The products are used in automotive display systems, new energy vehicle powertrains, central control systems, seats, lighting, and autonomous driving modules. Additionally, the company serves electric bicycle manufacturers and garden machinery tool producers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with its headquarters and main production facilities in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province. It has expanded its global footprint by establishing wholly-owned subsidiaries and production bases in Singapore and Thailand to serve Southeast Asian markets. The company exports products internationally, with sales in North America, Europe, and Southeast Asia, leveraging overseas sales consultants to penetrate advanced magnesium alloy markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Sinyuan ZM Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of precision die-cast magnesium and aluminum alloy components. It integrates upstream mold design and manufacturing with downstream die casting, machining, surface treatment, and quality inspection, providing one-stop solutions to automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers. The company also manages procurement of raw materials and auxiliary materials but does not engage in raw material extraction or final vehicle assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on becoming a leader in magnesium alloy lightweight solutions, emphasizing innovation in magnesium alloy precision casting technology and expanding applications in automotive lightweighting. R&D priorities include advancing semi-solid die casting technology, developing large and complex magnesium alloy automotive parts, and enhancing product performance such as surface smoothness, strength, and corrosion resistance. The company collaborates with academic institutions for material and process innovation and invests in global capacity expansion, especially in Southeast Asia.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized magnesium and aluminum alloy precision die-cast components and molds to automotive manufacturers and related industries. The company operates on an order-driven production model supplemented by pre-production inventory for urgent orders. Sales are conducted via direct sales channels supported by targeted marketing, technical exchanges, and supplier audits. The company also earns investment income from financial products but this is non-recurring.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ningbo Sinyuan ZM Technology is positioned as a high-tech enterprise with a strong first-mover advantage in magnesium alloy die casting within China. It holds numerous patents and certifications and is recognized as a key backbone enterprise in the die casting mold industry. The company competes with other domestic and international die casting manufacturers but differentiates itself through integrated mold and casting capabilities, advanced technologies, and established relationships with leading automotive brands. The company aims to strengthen its Tier 1 supplier status and expand market share amid increasing competition in magnesium alloy lightweighting.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 408.6 million, representing a 16.01% increase over 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 80.3 million, stable compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.25 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.11 billion, showing steady growth. R&D investment accounted for over 5% of revenue, reflecting a commitment to innovation. The company has expanded its consolidated scope with new subsidiaries in Singapore and Thailand, supporting its growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive core technology system and integrated business model that covers mold design, die casting, machining, and surface treatment, enabling high-quality, precision, and lightweight magnesium alloy components. Its first-mover advantage in magnesium alloy die casting and continuous innovation in semi-solid casting technology provide superior product performance, including thin walls, complex shapes, and enhanced durability. The company’s close collaboration with leading automotive brands and rapid response capabilities ensure customized solutions that meet stringent quality and delivery requirements, establishing it as a trusted partner in automotive lightweighting.
